description.en: Drive Blender 3D modeling from the harness — create primitives, run boolean CSG (union/intersect/difference), transform, material, modifier, scene query, and export STL/OBJ/PLY/GLTF via a JSON bridge. Bundles a headless trimesh+manifold3d runtime (no Blender needed) and a Blender bpy add-on for full power. OOM-safe: geometry is exported to disk, never inlined into the tool channel.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中驱动 Blender 3D 建模——创建基本体、布尔运算（并/交/差）、变换、材质、修改器、场景查询，并通过 JSON 桥接导出 STL/OBJ/PLY/GLTF。内置无头 trimesh+manifold3d 运行时（无需安装 Blender）与 Blender bpy 插件以获得完整能力。防 OOM：几何体导出到磁盘，绝不内联进工具通道。
